name: breakhis-matched-three-way-v1

split.group_code_permutation: RandomState(seed).permutation(number of sorted unique conservative groups), assigned in sorted group order; randomizes ties without SGKF shuffle
split.stratification_unit: sorted subtype-qualified provider case, final-five target
split.selection: first lexicographic (test_fold, validation_fold) with all five targets in every role and at least two fitting conservative groups per target; remaining three folds fit

input.fields: all canonical original fields in each case; no cross-zoom correspondence assumed
input.crops: Pillow RGB bilinear resize shorter side224, then left/center/right224 squares; same pixels as accepted Midnight coverage cache
input.crop_aggregation: mean of three per-crop descriptors before field heads: Midnight native3072; CNN post-cls_norm512; Swin post-added-LayerNorm768
input.pooling: joint five-class probabilities: mean fields within zoom, then equal mean over active zooms
input.route: pooled malignant probability >=0.5 then malignant argmax, else benign

selection.metric: mean15 case macro F1 with all five labels
selection.test_access: selected candidate only, after validation selection receipt is sealed

training.sample_weights: class-balanced by fitting cases, equal case then zoom then field mass; each head normalized to mean1 across fitting fields; benign malignant-head weight0
training.batch_reduction: SUM(global_number_fitting_fields * unit_total_head_mass * sparseCE) / configured_batch_fields16, including partial batch; no random minibatch weight/mask normalization
training.schedule: at zero-based epoch e=0..39, lr=initial*(0.01+0.99*(1+cos(pi*e/39))/2); no validation-driven LR or stopping
training.augmentation: fixed field/epoch seed shared across CNN and Swin; rotate uniform[-90,90], horizontal/vertical flips, OpenCV linear/reflect101; same transform for three crops of a field
training.start: original pretrained weights only, no previous BreakHis-finetuned checkpoint
training.neural_output_adaptation: binary2 plus malignant4; benign subtype loss masked; CNN eight-type head replaced, originals preserved

midnight_p.fit: recompute all supports and head-specific centers from this fitting role only; never reuse prior fitted readouts

budget.bootstrap_unit: same resampled conservative test groups paired across three methods; all provider cases and15subsets stay together; fixed5labels even absent class

interpretation: New matched development comparison, not a faithful rerun of unchanged notebooks or a globally fresh clinical test. Same cases, labels, roles, crop information, subset conditions, prediction unit and four validation choices. Different pretrained readers and learning algorithms are deliberate full-pipeline differences. Original historical roles and all previous outcomes remain unchanged. No95% guarantee or novelty claim.
